name: Francis L. Hamilton
milestones: Married Elizabeth Phebe Deane (Clary, Hamilton) (m. 6 Sep 1829, Darke County, OH)
career: Kept a tavern at his home in Greenville, Ohio, licensed 1830 to 1837
sources: Hamilton family register (The Family of Francis Hamilton and Susan), in Bill Allen’s Further Research (February 2012)
notes: Register number 158.1a. In 1848 he became guardian of the nine minor children of his late brother-in-law Rudolph Ryan.
